nvitk.io.conversors.stl2nifti
=============================

.. py:module:: nvitk.io.conversors.stl2nifti

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Rasterize STL surfaces to labeled NIfTI volumes (VTK-based; CLI optional).



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.io.conversors.stl2nifti.run_stl2nifti
   nvitk.io.conversors.stl2nifti.stl2nifti


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: run_stl2nifti(input_path: str | pathlib.Path, reference_path: str | pathlib.Path, output_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, multifile: bool = False, multilabel: bool = False, overwrite: bool = False, log_level: str = 'INFO', reference_rule: str | None = None, reference_rule_mode: str = 'contains') -> list[str]

   Rasterize STL mesh(es) into label NIfTI volume(s) matched to a reference NIfTI's geometry.

   Supports both a single input/reference pair and (with *multifile*) batch mode
   over per-patient subdirectories; *multilabel* rasterizes multiple STLs in one
   input folder into a single multi-label output instead of one file per mesh.


.. py:function:: stl2nifti(input_path: str | pathlib.Path, reference_path: str | pathlib.Path, output_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, multifile: bool = False, multilabel: bool = False, overwrite: bool = False, log_level: str = 'INFO', reference_rule: str | None = None, reference_rule_mode: str = 'contains') -> str | list[str]

   Thin wrapper over :func:`run_stl2nifti` returning a single path instead of a list when there's exactly one output.
